summary: Iteration 22 post-refactor regression on WEB + shared BACKEND. Extracted routes/videos.py and routes/messages.py behave identically to the pre-refactor code — all Videos endpoints (list/detail/related/create/update/delete/like/view/comments/user-videos) and Messages endpoints (conversation list/create, message list/send, reactions) return correct responses. Removed /api/live and /api/rooms/* correctly 404. Web Profile has the new Reels tab, /reels/:id opens a fullscreen viewer with Back/Like/Mute controls, Back returns to /profile, Videos+Blogs+Posts tabs still work, /live and /rooms redirect to /, Discover shows only 3 tabs. 34/36 pytest checks pass. Two issues surfaced: (1) BUG: GET /api/conversations/{id}/typing returns 500 due to naive-vs-aware datetime compare in routes/messages.py:219 (offset-naive from Mongo vs offset-aware `now()` — same code lived in server.py before but is now surfaced through the refactor); (2) stale 'Go live'/'Audio livestreams' copy on the /login marketing panel (AuthLayout.jsx) — Live has been removed everywhere else.

critical.issue: Returns 500 TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes at /app/backend/routes/messages.py:219. Mongo returns stored typing timestamps as naive UTC while `cutoff = now() - timedelta(...)` is offset-aware. Fix: normalize with `.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` on `t` before comparing, or make `now()` return naive UTC consistently. This is exercised whenever the Messages screen polls typing indicators — silent 500s in prod.

minor.issue: Returns 400 instead of the more conventional 401 Unauthorized for wrong credentials. Not a refactor regression (server.py behavior).

action_items: HIGH — Fix the 500 in routes/messages.py::get_typing (line 217-220). Recommended fix: `t_aware = t.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) if t.tzinfo is None else t; if t_aware > cutoff: ...` (import timezone from datetime). Alternative: reuse the same normalization for message read timestamps too if they exhibit the same issue.
LOW — Update /app/frontend/src/components/AuthLayout.jsx lines 25-26 ('Go live.') and line 34 ('Audio livestreams') to remove Live references now that Live is removed sitewide.

OPTIONAL — Consider harmonizing `now()` in server.py to always return a naive-UTC (or always aware-UTC) datetime; mixing the two is the root cause here and can recur wherever a raw Mongo datetime is compared to `now()`.
critical_code_review_comments: routes/videos.py and routes/messages.py correctly avoid `from __future__ import annotations` — build_router closure over dependency names in Annotated[...] would break Depends resolution if stringified. This is documented in messages/videos file headers implicitly via the request note; verified by test pass.

routes/messages.py:219 comparison `t > cutoff` is fragile: Mongo motor returns naive datetimes by default while `now()` in server.py appears to return offset-aware UTC. This is the reason for the 500 today.
routes/videos.py::serialize_video reads `v['created_at']` unguarded — safe because create_video always sets it, but consider a `.get('created_at', now())` fallback for future proofing.

server.py:1818-1825 modular include order is fine, but each `from routes.X import build_router as _build_X` is imported inside a comment section — consider moving these to top-level imports once the load-order concerns are audited.

rca of the issue: GET /api/conversations/{conv_id}/typing 500: routes/messages.py stores typing timestamp via `$set: { typing.<uid>: now() }`. MongoDB motor stores/reads BSON dates as naive UTC datetimes. When the GET handler builds `cutoff = now() - timedelta(seconds=5)` (offset-aware) and compares `t > cutoff` with t from Mongo (offset-naive), Python raises `TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes`. Fix by normalizing t to UTC-aware before compare or by ensuring `now()` returns naive UTC. Reproduction: login as founder, POST /api/conversations/{cid}/typing (200), then GET /api/conversations/{cid}/typing (500). Confirmed in test_iteration22_refactor_regression.py::TestMessages::test_typing_post_and_get and backend.err.log stack trace.
